To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
life satisfaction, anxiety and resilience are associated with age in men, while depression does not show an association with age.

(a) life satisfaction is strongly influenced by the absence of anxiety, depression and vulnerability factors (b) life satisfaction is also influenced by social and personal resources and (c) there is evidence for a midlife crisis in men.
life satisfaction, anxiety and depression are stable across the life span in the male community.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the importance of personal and social resources for life satisfaction and distress across the life span.
the identification of factors which may be helpful for a healthy and satisfied ageing of men.
the importance of resilience as a protective resource against the negative consequences of ageing.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
life satisfaction is not age-related in men.
ageing is a process that is characterized by a variety of individual and social factors that influence life satisfaction and well-being.
ageing is not necessarily accompanied by a decline in life satisfaction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
life satisfaction in ageing German men is not only dependent on the absence of anxiety, depression and unemployment, but also on the presence of a partner and a good income.
life satisfaction in men is not a matter of ageing, but of vulnerability factors and personal and social resources.
life satisfaction is not only a function of age but also a function of vulnerability and resources.
The main takeaway from our work is that
life satisfaction and distress are not age-dependent.
resilience and life satisfaction are strongly interrelated, and that the absence of distress is a prerequisite for a good quality of life.

the absence of anxiety, depression and unemployment and the presence of a partner, a good household net income and a high level of resilience are the key factors in maintaining life satisfaction across the life span in men.
